name: HappyScribe
description:
Connect HappyScribe to give Claude on-demand access to your organization's conversational memory: every transcript, meeting recording, interview, and quote, speaker-attributed, verbatim, in 150+ languages.

HappyScribe is an AI notetaker and transcription platform that captures every conversation: online meetings, in-person recordings, interviews, fieldwork, uploaded media. It turns them into searchable, citable, structured knowledge with verbatim accuracy: what was actually said, by whom, in what language.

What Claude can do with HappyScribe connected:
- Search your library by keyword, speaker, date, or topic
- Pull exact quotes with verified timestamps and deep links to the editor
- Transcribe new media from a URL (YouTube, Vimeo, direct links)
- Manage folders, rename speakers, and edit transcript text
- Diagnose why a meeting wasn't recorded
- Explore the people and companies graph across your recordings

Best-in-class multilingual accuracy across 150+ languages. European and GDPR-native.

_published_faq.name: How do I add HappyScribe to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add HappyScribe to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://www.happyscribe.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the HappyScribe MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: HappyScribe lists 40 MCP tools, including create_folder, create_summary_template, create_transcription, delete_folder, delete_summary_template, delete_transcriptions, get_company, get_folder_hierarchy, get_glossary, get_helpdesk_article, get_meeting_diagnostics, and get_person.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to HappyScribe?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to HappyScribe in communication on the Manufact MCP catalog include AgentLine: Phone Numbers for AI Agents, JooVoice, OpenMail, Granola, and Fleet Connected Apps.
HappyScribe requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
HappyScribe is developed by Happy Scribe Limited. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
